about_the_game:
The Universe was so bored with spheres, sooo last terayear of a shape, rings are IN! It plotted and schemed and the Chaine was born, where six rings came together to form a stunning galaxy.

Up With Doznik is a first-person action adventure roguelite with shapeshifting at it's heart. 

After a rather hard fall, you find yourself inexplicably plonked into a strange land. The dwarf, Doznik, decides you’re his best bet for survival (despite your looks), helps you get on your feet, and demands you protect him on the road to the castle—a road conveniently packed with shapeshifting monsters who probably aren't interested in a friendly chat.

Arm yourself with whatever scrap of weaponry you can find (it's mostly sticks, cheese, and sheer willpower) and brew the most vile potions the rings of Chaine have ever seen. Experiment with different builds and upgrade your arsenal with every run—because what doesn’t kill you… will probably just kill you but with slightly more sass, who are we kidding.

FIGHT SHAPESHIFTING MONSTERS

A relentless horde of shapeshifting fiends await at every turn. You’ll need more than just guts and a stick to survive, they’ve got tricks up their sleeves that would make a magician jealous.

DEAL WITH DEATH

Turns out, Death's got a side gig. When you're not busy dying, he's out there selling permanent upgrades to make your next inevitable demise just a little bit more... survivable. It’s all part of the service, he’s very hands-on about your progress, you're his #1 customer after all.

FIGURE OUT THE CASTLE'S SECRETS

Doznik’s obsession with reaching the castle borders on unhealthy, and nothing—nothing—is going to stop him, not even your incompetence. What’s so special about this castle? Is it really worth the hassle, or is it just a glorified tourist trap?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500, Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050, RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700, Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080, RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A failed accountant finds himself on an unfamiliar ring. Rescued by a dwarf, they head for the castle, equipped with a mildly menacing stick, questionable potions, and a dream. Fight shapeshifting monsters, upgrade, die, repeat—and grow stronger each time.
